_comment: RECORDED, NOT HAND-WRITTEN. Every `stderr` below is verbatim combined stdout+stderr from the `command` beside it, produced by the recorded tool version. Re-record with `node packages/apra-fleet-se/test/fixtures/vcs-stderr/record-vcs-stderr.mjs`; see ./README.md. Do NOT edit a `stderr` value by hand -- a hand-edited sample is exactly the defect this corpus was created to remove.

samples.command: bd dolt push   (two clones with independent Dolt histories, remote already advanced)
samples.stderr:
Pushing to Dolt remote...
Error: push to origin/main: Error 1105: unknown push error; no common ancestor

Local and remote Dolt histories have diverged.
This means the local database and the remote have independent commit
histories with no common merge base.

Recovery options:

  1. Keep remote, discard local (recommended if remote is authoritative):
       bd bootstrap              # re-clone from remote

  2. Keep local, overwrite remote (if local is authoritative):
       bd dolt push --force       # force-push local history to remote

  3. Manual recovery (re-initialize local database):
       rm -rf .beads/dolt         # delete local Dolt database
       bd bootstrap              # re-clone from remote

Tip: This usually happens when multiple agents independently initialize
databases and push to the same remote. Use 'bd bootstrap' to clone an
existing remote instead of 'bd init' to avoid divergent histories.
samples.note: the "have diverged" token that earns the diverged verdict is on the FOURTH line -- truncating this output to its first line flips the verdict to unknown
